fusions.name: Plate-Splitting Cast
fusions.desc: Hurls your spear up to 8 tiles, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, and ignoring the target's armour.

fusions.name: Hedge of Points
fusions.desc: Plants a hedge of spearpoints 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that blocks enemies. Each enemy that runs into it is knocked 2.5 tiles back, and the hedge deals 10 damage to it.

fusions.name: Lowered Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you 4 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Braced Point
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying any of your conditions, your damage rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 6%.
